verdict.rationale: Skyfire has no native natural-language console, but its official MCP server (mcp.skyfire.xyz) lets an MCP-capable AI agent discover sellers and create kya/pay/kya-pay tokens. That makes natural-language operation of core buyer workflows possible indirectly through a third-party agent client. Most other operations (service creation, API keys, approval) are documented only through the dashboard or REST API. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface, MCP/NL coverage of seller-side and admin operations such as charging tokens and creating services, and independent hands-on corroboration of NL-driven workflows.
